name: MIRACL-FR-Reranking-benchmark
description: A French-language reranking benchmark derived from the MIRACL corpus that measures how well systems reorder candidate documents/passages for relevance given a query. It is intended to evaluate reranking models and retrieval pipelines in French. Typical use involves reordering a fixed candidate set and reporting standard ranking metrics.
reputation: Part of the MIRACL family, respected in multilingual IR research with moderate community usage for reranking evaluations.
